title: 제주특별자치도 설치 및 국제자유도시 조성을 위한 특별법 제363조제5항에 따른 범칙금 양정기준에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 제주특별자치도 설치 및 국제자유도시 조성을 위한 특별법 제363조제5항에 따른 범칙금 양정기준에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Reduction of Administrative Fines)
(1) The head of an immigration office, the head of a branch office of an immigration office or the head of an immigration detention center may reduce an administrative fine under Article 2 by up to one-half of the amount determined by the criteria under Article 2, in consideration of the offender's age and circumstances, motives for and consequences of the violation, ability to pay the fine, number of previous violations, etc.
(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), where the head of an immigration office, head of a branch office of an immigration office or head of an immigration detention center intends to reduce an administrative fine by more than one-half of the amount prescribed by the assessment criteria, the head shall obtain prior approval from the Minister of Justice, accompanied by materials explaining the grounds for the proposed reduction.
